candidate_limit_evaluation.admission_rule_required: Admission must calculate the exact future canonical v3 bytes after certificate, reward, native transaction, and finality-required data are fixed, and reject when it exceeds the complete-block cap. Per-media caps alone cannot prove block fit.
candidate_limit_evaluation.unbounded_inputs: No safe complete-block cap can be finalized until certificate votes/signature sizes, native transaction count/size, captions, and finality attachment placement each have explicit protocol maxima.

measurement_boundary.current_v1_v2: direct measurement of Block.consensus_payload_v1_bytes using deterministic, schema-shaped generated fixtures; no finalized production blocks were present in this runner.
measurement_boundary.projected_v3: deterministic construction from the proposed v3 schema and protocol-v2-style canonical envelope. It is not accepted by current production code and is not a production block.
measurement_boundary.sqlite: isolated temporary databases using the current SQLiteStorageBackend and unchanged schema; v3 rows exercise only its JSON-section storage behavior, not a future authoritative v3 schema.

methodology.metadata_denominator: nonmedia_metadata_bytes / complete_serialized_block_bytes; nonmedia means every exact serialized byte outside the one media field, including envelopes, delimiters, certificate, transactions, header, and all structural fields.
methodology.percentiles: equal-block nearest-rank percentile: sorted[ceil(n*p/100)-1]. Each representation has 36 rows, so p99 is a descriptive nearest-rank value rather than a robust tail estimate.
methodology.signature_accounting: signature_bytes_subset is diagnostic only and is contained in certificate_bytes and transaction_record_bytes; it is not added to reconciliation totals.
